exposure: History of surgical procedures (laparotomy, laparoscopy, gynecologically related procedures, cesarean section, and surgeries on torso and extremities)
outcome: Risk of endometriosis (diagnosed as ovarian endometrioma)
cohort: 208 patients with ovarian endometrioma and 212 age-matched patients with ovarian teratoma
finding: Both laparotomy and cesarean section were found to be independently associated with an increased risk of endometriosis.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with a 2-fold increase in the risk of endometriosis (OR = 2.16, 95% CI = 1.31-3.55).
